cost.description: Long-term storage and dark archive backup for UAV imagery dataset. Minimum 5 years post-project. CoreTrustSeal certified infrastructure.
cost.title: LifeBlock repository storage

dataset.description: UAV RGB imagery and derived segmentation masks of coastal habitats in Cádiz Bay, collected during MARBEFES field campaigns in 2025. Includes orthomosaics and classified land-cover layers produced via U-Net deep learning pipeline. Dataset supports coastal biodiversity monitoring and ecosystem service assessment.
dataset.title: Coastal imagery set – Cádiz 2025

data_quality_assurance: QA/QC following ISO 19157. Minimum image overlap >80%, cloud/shadow cover <10%, sharpness metric threshold applied. Expert annotation validated against field survey ground-truth points. QC report available at repository landing page.
dataset.description: Dataset will be made FAIR following RDA and Horizon Europe requirements. A DOI will be assigned via DataCite for Findability. Data will be openly accessible via LifeBlock repository (OAI-PMH, REST API). Metadata follows DataCite 4.5 and Darwin Core standards for Interoperability. CC-BY 4.0 license ensures Reusability. FAIR assessment will be performed using F-UJI as part of OSTrails Thematic Pilot 7 activities.

format: README file, field campaign protocol (EURODRONE-2025-01), processing pipeline description, EUNIS habitat classification codebook, and QC report (ISO 19157) included with dataset deposit.

metadata.description: Metadata follows DataCite Metadata Schema 4.5 and Darwin Core standards. Fields include: title, abstract, keywords, creators, DOI, license, spatial coverage (WKT/EPSG:4326), temporal coverage, format, and related outputs. These standards are widely adopted in biodiversity and environmental research communities.

dataset.title: FAIR data

dataset.description: No ethical issues identified for MARBEFES coastal biodiversity datasets. Data consist entirely of environmental remote sensing observations with no involvement of human subjects, personal data, or sensitive information.
dataset.rights: Ethics Assessment – MARBEFES UAV Coastal Data
dataset.title: Ethics Assessment – MARBEFES UAV Coastal Data

dataset.description: Data security for MARBEFES datasets is ensured through LifeWatch ERIC institutional infrastructure, which incorporates blockchain-based integrity verification via LifeBlock. All datasets are stored with cryptographic hash verification ensuring tamper-proof provenance tracking. No personal or sensitive data is involved, simplifying the security framework significantly.
dataset.title: Data security

dmp.description: Machine-actionable DMP for the MARBEFES Horizon Europe project, covering coastal biodiversity monitoring datasets collected via UAV and remote sensing. Produced as part of OSTrails Thematic Pilot 7 (ENVRI/LifeWatch ERIC).
